fact: President Macky Sall said the State had begun finalising the national AI strategy (SNIA), structured around six strategic orientations, under the technical lead of the ministry in charge of communications, telecommunications and digital affairs.
IDRC's grant record for the AI Living Lab in Dakar, dated September 2024, says Senegal has published a national AI strategy.
IDRC's activity description states that Senegal has published a national AI strategy.

The Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Economy published the summary of Senegal's national AI strategy and roadmap to 2028 (four objectives, six orientations), whose formulation it launched on 17 May 2023; the document gives no month, so as_of is its publication year.
